name: Ksenia

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning! Let's do our best today!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Work gets tiring in the afternoon. So how about some extra pay?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Today's haul looks good! One, two... eh? Only two thousand and five hundred!?

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: I should stop counting money at night. My mood worsens at the sight of my pitiful wallet!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: If I won this month's employee of the month award, I won't have to worry about money for half a year... hehe...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Welcome! Which beer would you like? Draft beer? Or craft beer? How about some snacks? Oh, don't forget to tip afterwards.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Professor? Did you run off somewhere again?

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'm going shopping today! Professor, are you coming with me?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Ahaha!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Not bad!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: That will take a service fee!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: You're paying for overtime, right?

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Hello there! Ksenia, here to serve! Of course, you'll be billed separately for services outside of my working hours.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: With my efficiency improved, I can help more customers and get more tips!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Don't worry! You can leave everything to me as long as you're paying me on time!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Only those with dreams can have a future! And my dream is to have all the money in the world!

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: You can look forward to my perfect performance!

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Off we go!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: A mortal strike!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Mission complete!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Please confirm my invoice!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: No way...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: What a surprise! I can't believe you're choosing me as your partner! Then, I guess from now on... Your everything will be mine, and my everything yours!

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Restaurants and bars stay open on New Year's Day. There's also going to be a lot of customers. This way I'll be able to collect even more tips than usual! Hehe!

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: What do you feel about this chocolate, Professor? From the packaging to the camellia hidden inside, it's all specifically prepared by me, fufu! So, all this is going to cost you extra!

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: Are these the watermelons used during Tanabata? If we were to sell them all, we'd make quite the profit, no?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: I heard that whoever finds a coin in the pumpkin pie is going to get rich! So in order for me to find that coin, I brought the whole thing over to... Woah! They're still chasing me!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: There are a lot of discount events going on during Christmas... So I may have bought a little too much! Uh, Professor, help me please... I-I'm tripping over!

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Allow Ksenia to provide you with an exclusive special service today! It's your birthday after all! It'll even be free of charge!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
The cardinal rule of the food service industry is as such: a clumsy waiter won't get any tips! Without tips, your salary isn't enough to buy the things you want.
Therefore, if you want to earn money you will have to look competent, and never embarrass yourself in front of customers!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Do you go to beer halls often? While the smell can get unbearable and there's lots of eccentric characters, the atmosphere can get surprisingly pleasant! Work long enough in places like that, and you'll learn a lot of interesting things.

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: It's human nature to be a cheapskate! Whenever there's a sale, I'm always the first one there! Spending the least to buy the best, that's one of life's most essential skills! It's essential, critical and crucial! Ah, the convenience store is going to sell their bentos at a discount, how about you come with me to buy some, Professor? There won't be any left if you're late!

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Earn money happily, then go shopping with joy. That's how simple a happy life can be, to the point of being a bit boring, I guess.
On the contrary, those who have a lot of money but whine about everything all day are pathetic.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Say, do you want to try experiencing life as a part-time restaurant worker, Professor? If there's anything you don't understand or need help on, I'll be there to teach you! Just change your clothes and let's go!

career:
The Waitress 3.0 is a third-generation catering service Doll produced by Universal Anything Services (UAS). In comparison to the previous two generations, the third generation looks more humanlike and also carries a complete deep-learning module, allowing it to cater to its guest's needs and provide an exquisite dining experience. 

Ksenia excels in meeting a guest's needs and requirements. She works in the chain restaurant вкусный, where she is well known for her lively image and high-quality service. She has been named the "Golden Waitress" for several years in a row and, when Project Neural Cloud opened its doors, she was selected as an outstanding Doll representative to participate in the test.
infoStories:
Compared to other industries, the use of robots in the service industry has a long history. The second-generation Dolls, which were made to emulate living beings, had an agreeable appearance, high efficiency, and low error rates. After the war, they were particularly well-received. 

Among all of the catering service Dolls released by UAS, Ksenia is one of the most outstanding. No matter the weather, you can always see her bustling about tirelessly in the dining area all year round. Moreover, no matter how long she has worked or how picky the guest is, Ksenia always appears with a gentle smile and provides impeccable service. She perfectly embodies a Doll's specialties of high precision and tolerance, and guests who receive her honest and warm reception almost always find themselves habitually leaving generous tips.

Just two months after opening, вкусный ascended to the top of the list of the most popular restaurants in the area, in no small part due to Ksenia's contributions. 

Unlike some of her more rigid colleagues, Ksenia always thinks deeply about how she can improve her service and let guests leave feeling even more satisfied. She crafts greetings appropriate to a guest's age and style to give them a better first impression. She commits regular guests' orders to memory to make them feel more at home. She learned the trick to carrying a dozen beer cups all at the same time, transforming the normal act of serving into an impressive show for the guests. These "tips" for getting tips are engraved in her Neural Cloud.

Soon, more and more guests were enraptured by Ksenia and her bountiful spirit. What she sells isn't merely a service, but also a cozy atmosphere where people can, just for a moment, forget all their woes. 

"If you're having a bad day, go visit Ksenia at вкусный!"
—Local Club's Message Board

However, even her regulars don't know that what Ksenia actually desires to see most is not their satisfied faces, but the plentiful tips that fill up her wallet afterwards. That is her ultimate motivation for improving her service. To say she won't miss any opportunities to improve, is to say she won't miss any opportunities to earn money.

When a rest day arrives, Ksenia is itching to leave work so that she can rush to go shopping, filling her dormitory with purchases until it's near bursting at the seams. Converting all the money she earned during the week into her favorite things gives Ksenia a feeling of accomplishment that she doesn't get from work. 

In a sense, Ksenia's life philosophy is very pure: Work happily, earn money, use the money to buy things you like, work even more happily. This money-driven cycle is perhaps the source of her endless vitality.

Gathering money is not actually a command written into Ksenia's code, but is more of a "law of survival" that she has learned over the course of her work. Due to the nature of her job, Ksenia naturally comes in contact with all sorts of people. People tend to use their eating time to engage in more detailed conversations. The seemingly innocent Ksenia has already secretly accumulated experience unimaginable by a normal person. With her impressive learning and analytic abilities, she has gained a unique understanding of people's interactions and the world.

She has met guests who were anxious, angry, or in dire straits due to a lack of savings. She has also met guests who were distrustful, restrained, or paralyzed due to hanging onto their money. In her mind, money is all-powerful, able to buy anything in the world; at the same time, money is powerless, as money left unspent is the least useful thing in existence. 

So she thus came to a conclusion. If you can't make money, you cannot feel at ease. If you can't spend money, you too cannot feel at ease. Working hard to earn money and then freely spending it is the correct way to live. Somehow, this rather mechanical conclusion allows her to live more freely than humans.

It was not difficult for Ksenia to adapt to life in the Oasis. As long as there is someone willing to contract her services, she will appear. Now the Oasis has gathered together many Dolls of outstanding characters. One wants to open a chocolatory, another wants to host a concert, and another even wants to build a tea garden. Ksenia does not lack potential employers. Until then, she will take the time to make some sweet treats or serve tea to those in need. 

Still, once her services are accepted, she requires a bit of Diggcoin as proof of your "sincerity"—otherwise, be prepared to spend an entire day with her giving you dirty looks.
oathDesc: You're the only one who gets these special services, okay?

projections.name: Active Waiter
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"Don't worry about the amount of work she has at hand. It is a must for a waitress to be able to juggle between tasks. She has promised to make you feel at home here, and she will deliver."

projections.name: Special Reception
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"The key to making a fortune as a service provider is to make your customer feel you're offering something unique—they will only pay for what they feel is worthwhile. That's what she's good at."

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Shhh, don't let anyone else see it. This is a gift that only my special customers get."

skinList.name: Violet-Budded Banquet
skinList.desc:
Gala Dreams Series—Countless colors weave together to create resplendent dreams on this memorable evening ball, which slowly blends into the shades of the night.
This lavish dinner is her home field, and she weaves nimbly through it while delivering a warm reception to every guest. Tonight, her sights are set on your smile and your tips!
"Ah, it's you, Professor! Welcome! I've saved you a seat! This way, please!"
